title: 上任仅两年：斯塔默宣布辞职，英国接下来由谁接手？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Thank you very much and good morning. I am about to visit his Majesty, the King, to
segments.zh: 非常感谢，早上好。我即将觐见国王陛下，

segments.en: offer my resignation and close the book on my time as Prime Minister. My work is done.
segments.zh: 递交辞呈，结束我的首相任期。我的工作已经完成。

segments.en: In six and a half years, I took our party from a historic defeat in 2019, changed it so
segments.zh: 在六年半的时间里，我带领我们党从2019年的历史性失败中走出，

segments.en: it was fit to face the country and won a landslide general election victory in 2024. Since then,
segments.zh: 使其能够面对国家，并在2024年赢得压倒性大选胜利。此后，

segments.en: it has been the privilege of my life to serve you and this great country as Prime Minister.
segments.zh: 作为首相为你们和这个伟大国家服务，是我一生的荣幸。

segments.en: And I am confident that Britain is now stronger and fairer than it was two years ago.
segments.zh: 我相信，现在的英国比两年前更强大、更公平。
